reason: Provides model-powered analysis of local images and documents through CLI or HTTP transports, plus optional text-to-image generation with local output files.

summaries.zh: 通过命令行或 HTTP 模型服务分析本地图像和文档，并可根据文本提示生成图像文件。
summaries.en: Analyzes local images and documents through CLI or HTTP model services and can generate image files from text prompts.

capabilities: Reads local image and document files
Sends file content to configured model APIs or CLI tools
Spawns configured Codex or Hermes command-line processes
Generates and writes image files locally
